description: Unit test class for RecruitmentAttachmentDao, testing CRUD operations related to vacancy attachment data in a recruitment plugin for OrangeHRM.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing RecruitmentAttachmentDao functionalities, including saving, retrieving, and deleting vacancy attachments.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating the DAO and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a vacancy attachment and verifying the saved data.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentContentById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of vacancy attachment by ID and verifies attachment details.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests fetching multiple attachments for a vacancy ID and verifying their properties.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple attachments and confirms they no longer exist.
